City Safari

Pokémon GO City Safari: Boston (Rescheduled)

Sat, Oct 24, 2026, 10:00 AM → Sun, Oct 25, 2026, 6:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

This event has ended.

Boston's City Safari was postponed by a nor'easter and now runs mostly as a global event, for people who already bought a ticket. No new tickets are sold.

SEE CURRENT EVENTS

How it works

  • Ticket holders can play from anywhere, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. local time on Oct 24 and 25.
  • The wild encounters and bonuses planned for Boston run worldwide for ticket holders.
  • There's no Boston GO Stamp Rally this time.

If you're in Boston

  • Extra Special Research for spinning PokéStops in Boston: up to nine Eevee encounters in an explorer hat per ticketed day, each with a Boston location background.

Refunds

  • The buyer can ask in-app support for a refund until Oct 20 at 11:59 p.m. EST. It refunds the whole order and removes event access.

Tip

Nothing to do if you're keeping your ticket: just play during the hours.
